components: An alternating reciprocal shuttle uses four addressable cells, a shared role bit, and full-configuration equality. With separated fixed binary encoding and no extra persistent state, affine and one-AND circuits admit only the scoped short cycles; a two-Toffoli ternary factor supplies the longer examples.

A six-symbol relay supplies a diagonal identification and a relative two-cell incidence analyzer. Full-state triple reversal makes the even words commute; a coordinate echo alone does not enforce this on a carried bit.

The four-symbol relay, reciprocal link-bit lifts and independently supplied orthogonal rotations are controls. The finite quotient fits two solo rows without fixing mixed-word returns across these families.
candidates.declared_status: Finite reversible constructions and conditional resource arguments. Full-orbit period is not a six-valued local reading, and the coordinate echo does not select the full dynamics.
missing_bridges: Derive the physical cells, compatible state encoding and addressable reciprocal actuation rather than supplying them as circuitry or endpoint equivalence.
Specify how a local preparation and analyzer access the required relative symbol or carried bit, and justify which echo laws apply to complete physical states.

components: An oriented six-cycle from opposition and a three-cycle, a fixed three-mark incidence detector, and a supplied two-fair-choice preparation give the full six-setting fringe. The row fixes three masses, not the history law.

Fixed-spare scatterers and a single homogeneous mixture have scoped failures; alternating two scatterers with a stored site gives a passing fringe rival. An aligned singleton preparation and a second detector distinguish that rival from the direct rotor.

Frozen mixed-pulse holdouts compare unchanged four fair tickets with a separately supplied 60-degree rotation family. Transparent shuttles and unrestricted six-mark permutations have different survivor sets; some unrestricted rivals fit a calibration and first holdout but miss the second.
candidates.declared_status: Conditional incidence and exact arithmetic comparisons. Quarter-grid gaps assume fixed equal-weight histories and a deterministic terminal detector; neither these gaps nor the scoped stationary failures exclude arbitrary alternatives.
missing_bridges: Derive an actuator producing the active six-cycle and separately accessible pulse settings, rather than treating passive relabeling or the extra alternating site as their origin.
Supply repeatable physical preparation and incidence readout with loss accounted for, and independently freeze any rotation comparison before observing held-out words.

components: Fresh independent six-position choices, one counted forward register per cut, trial-static shared randomness and every emission scored. The five-station four-symbol and eight-station five-symbol bounds are Fourier partition certificates; a six-state accumulator with separately supplied stochastic readout is a positive control.

In the two-reader comparison, reproducing the static six-by-six probability table needs fewer messages than computing each microscopic incidence bit; the trit protocol averages adjacent pairs and fair ties.

The unmodified shuttle does not convey Alice's cell to Bob across the stated cut. The mobile carrier is an addition. Setting-conditioned omissions can fake a detected-only score; even a six-state carrier may fail the bound with degraded readout.
candidates.declared_status: Exact finite controls within stated information and loss contracts, not evidence of quantum memory, experimental replication, or an independently observable local symbol on the relay quotient.
missing_bridges: Identify what the physical cut carries, including timing, additional writable references and the role of shared preparation, and show that settings and denominators meet the scoring contract.
Derive or independently establish a local readout and communication mechanism rather than inferring microscopic comparison or memory size from a matched conditional table.

components: A finite reversible two-cell coupler uses occupation and six logical phase tags plus padding; two couplers exchange the raw cells. The same gate is used for preset shutters against independently prepared vacancies.

A three-bit supplied preparation and supplied local dial shifts yield the six rates, while the terminal detector reads occupation only. Dump occupancy accounts for blocked emissions without discarding losses.

A separate empty-silent, no-other-setting-channel argument prevents a unit endpoint change after a fair split. In the implemented raw coupler a conserved coarse tag count blocks a clean +1 dial with exactly restored auxiliaries.
candidates.declared_status: Finite exclusive-routing toy with a selected reversible completion, not a derived actuator or microscopic particle model. The actuation wall applies to this completion and contract.
missing_bridges: Supply an independently justified physical phase actuator, or a different native completion with a checked implementation of the dial and its accounted auxiliaries.
Relate integer occupation, source stock and shutter dumps to physical preparation, conserved energy and exclusive detector records.

components: Supplied five-slot hard-core occupations, legal forward/reverse toggles, and reciprocal carried edge bits. Vertex frame changes leave the parity around a square invariant; compare it to the bit difference after reversing two legal instructions.

Curvature invariance under all slot permutations or a supplied 3+2 split is weaker than selecting all-odd squares. Flat, pure-gauge parity-tag, all-odd Jordan-Wigner and split spectator-dependent textures are distinct controls, except that the two flat controls have the same curvature.
A curvature-preserving permutation admits a vacuum-normalized vertex correction. That formal lift is not identified with a physical swap.
candidates.declared_status: Finite signed-operation classification on supplied slots. All-odd curvature yields formal anticommutation; it is not forced by occupations and does not imply a physical spin-statistics law.
missing_bridges: Explain native selection and phase-sensitive readout of square curvature that distinguishes all-odd signs from invariant flat and mixed alternatives.
Relate addressed toggles and corrected permutations to physically implemented creation and exchange of indistinguishable excitations.

components: For supplied one-family left-Weyl multiplets and conventional four-dimensional local anomalies the rational solutions have three branches. One supplied scalar doublet and conventional Yukawa links restrict to the hypercharge and B-minus-L plane.

A supplied bare sterile self-pair with a neutral constant coefficient reduces that plane to the hypercharge line including zero; a number projector does not. The matched affine exterior charge formula is a crosswalk, not independent evidence.

Three families with diagonal Yukawa links and full-rank sterile support need not be universal: paired opposite sterile charges and a disconnected lepton support preserve a flavor-difference direction. A supplied connectivity condition removes it in the tested system.
candidates.declared_status: Exact rational charge diagnostics with imported multiplets and interaction support. No inference of Majorana masses, observed mixing, gauge dynamics, or a charge unit.
missing_bridges: Derive particle identifications, gauge representations and the actual allowed neutral pairings rather than imposing benchmark field content and link supports.
Establish which family links and mass operators occur with charge-preserving coefficients; selection of a line does not fix normalization or scales.

components: Compare a published direct free-neutron charge estimate to a supplied charge plane, conventional diagonal quotient, electromagnetic readout and valence dictionary. Fixing the positive scalar character h=3 gives a discrete nonzero gap; changing it admits inequivalent primitive ratios arbitrarily near zero without changing the quotient.

Two published appearance links constrain active flavor charges only under an exact unbroken U(1), definite-charge tags, neutral transfer in every propagation Kraus branch, and the supplied interpretation of the measurements.

Conserving total charge with reservoir exchange is compatible with nonzero appearance between differently charged flavors. Same-charge controls can have different dynamics and the same flavor table; connected active charges do not fix a common shift or the sterile sector.
candidates.declared_status: Conditional comparisons using published summaries as inputs; no new experiment or fit. The bulk-matter converted bound is not used as a second neutron anchor, and appearance counts are not treated as transition probabilities.
missing_bridges: Independently justify the scalar weight, charge lattice, electromagnetic normalization and composition dictionary before transferring the fixed-weight neutron comparison to physical charge selection.
Justify charge-sharp preparation and detection and bound hidden exchange before treating appearance as a charge-equality test; this does not determine a neutrino dynamics.
